title: Now-fan heptad = imaginary octonion frame

key_identifications.fano_plane: PG(2,2) geometry on 7 now-fan fixed points

conclusion: The 7-point now-fan IS the imaginary octonion frame / Fano plane. 3 fixed GQ lines = 3 Fano lines through now. |Aut(Fano)| = 168 = lambda^q*q*7 substrate-pure. 7 = q! + 1 ties Fano order to compiler diameter.
